target_claim: For real x away from the poles of Gamma and real y, the absolute-value ratio |Gamma(x+iy)/Gamma(x)| equals the displayed infinite product with exponent -1.
source_quote:
The absolute value of the $\Gamma$ function is given by the formula \cite{AS72}, \[
\left|\frac{\Gamma(x+iy)}{\Gamma(x)}\right| = \left\{\prod_{n=0}^\infty \left(1+\frac{y^2}{(n+x)^2}\right)\right\}^{-1}.
\]
